title: WHEN Neutral SUMMARIES ARE NOT THAT Neutral: QUANTIFYING POLITICAL NEUTRALITY IN LLM-GENERATED NEWS SUMMARIES

bias_targets.methodology: The paper generates neutral, pro-Democratic, and pro-Republican news summaries using various LLMs, and compares the default (neutral) summaries to the partisan ones. It evaluates bias using diverging vocabulary analysis (token bias scores to identify partisan terminology) and SentenceTransformer-based text classifiers to compute a Polarization Index based on how easily distinguishable default summaries are from explicitly aligned summaries.
